defmodule PdfGen.TenantContext do
  @moduledoc "Manages tenant isolation for PDF generation requests"

  defstruct [:tenant_id, :user_id, :role, :permissions]

  def build_context(conn) do
    %__MODULE__{
      tenant_id: conn.assigns[:tenant_id],
      user_id: conn.assigns[:user_id],
      role: conn.assigns[:role],
      permissions: conn.assigns[:permissions] || []
    }
  end

  def authorized?(context, resource_tenant_id) do
    context.tenant_id == resource_tenant_id
  end
end

defmodule PdfGen.TemplateRegistry do
  @moduledoc "Registry for PDF templates with tenant scoping"

  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)
  end

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def register_template(pid, tenant_id, template_id, template_data) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:register, tenant_id, template_id, template_data})
  end

  def get_template(pid, tenant_id, template_id) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:get, tenant_id, template_id})
  end

  def resolve_template(pid, template_ref) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:resolve, template_ref})
  end

  def handle_call({:register, tenant_id, template_id, data}, _from, state) do
    key = {tenant_id, template_id}
    ref = generate_ref(tenant_id, template_id)
    new_state = Map.put(state, key, %{data: data, ref: ref})
    new_state = Map.put(new_state, {:ref, ref}, %{tenant_id: tenant_id, template_id: template_id, data: data})
    {:reply, {:ok, ref}, new_state}
  end

  def handle_call({:get, tenant_id, template_id}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state, {tenant_id, template_id}) do
      nil -> {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      entry -> {:reply, {:ok, entry}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:resolve, ref}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state, {:ref, ref}) do
      nil -> {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      entry -> {:reply, {:ok, entry}, state}
    end
  end

  defp generate_ref(tenant_id, template_id) do
    :crypto.hash(:sha256, "#{tenant_id}:#{template_id}")
    |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
  end
end

defmodule PdfGen.RenderPipeline do
  @moduledoc "Multi-stage PDF rendering pipeline with tenant isolation"

  alias PdfGen.TenantContext
  alias PdfGen.TemplateRegistry

  defstruct [:context, :template, :data_sources, :render_opts, :parent_job]

  def new(context, opts \\ []) do
    %__MODULE__{
      context: context,
      template: nil,
      data_sources: [],
      render_opts: opts,
      parent_job: opts[:parent_job]
    }
  end

  def with_template(pipeline, registry_pid, template_id) do
    case TemplateRegistry.get_template(registry_pid, pipeline.context.tenant_id, template_id) do
      {:ok, entry} -> {:ok, %{pipeline | template: entry}}
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  def with_template_ref(pipeline, registry_pid, template_ref) do
    case TemplateRegistry.resolve_template(registry_pid, template_ref) do
      {:ok, entry} -> {:ok, %{pipeline | template: entry}}
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  def add_data_source(pipeline, source) do
    %{pipeline | data_sources: [source | pipeline.data_sources]}
  end

  def execute(%__MODULE__{} = pipeline) do
    with :ok <- validate_pipeline(pipeline),
         :ok <- check_authorization(pipeline),
         {:ok, rendered} <- render(pipeline) do
      {:ok, rendered}
    end
  end

  defp validate_pipeline(%{template: nil}), do: {:error, :no_template}
  defp validate_pipeline(%{context: nil}), do: {:error, :no_context}
  defp validate_pipeline(_), do: :ok

  defp check_authorization(%{context: context, template: template}) do
    if TenantContext.authorized?(context, template.tenant_id) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  defp render(%{template: template, data_sources: sources, render_opts: opts}) do
    # Simulate PDF rendering
    content = "PDF[template=#{inspect(template.data)}, sources=#{inspect(sources)}, opts=#{inspect(opts)}]"
    {:ok, content}
  end
end

defmodule PdfGen.CompositeRenderer do
  @moduledoc "Handles composite PDF documents that merge multiple templates"

  alias PdfGen.RenderPipeline
  alias PdfGen.TemplateRegistry

  def render_composite(context, registry_pid, template_refs, opts \\ []) do
    results =
      template_refs
      |> Enum.map(fn ref ->
        pipeline = RenderPipeline.new(context)

        with {:ok, pipeline} <- RenderPipeline.with_template_ref(pipeline, registry_pid, ref) do
          RenderPipeline.execute(pipeline)
        end
      end)

    errors = Enum.filter(results, &match?({:error, _}, &1))

    if Enum.empty?(errors) do
      pages = Enum.map(results, fn {:ok, content} -> content end)
      {:ok, Enum.join(pages, "\n---PAGE_BREAK---\n")}
    else
      {:error, :composite_render_failed, errors}
    end
  end
end
